extra_disposition: extra discovered cases are graded and reported; a false check in one is a FAIL, but they never count toward the graded agreement a PASS requires
required_set_source: tools/render_reverb_reference.py cmd_sweep default grid and trace naming (committed generator policy); pinned against the committed traces by tests/test_sxt024_sweep_coverage.py
verdict_rule: PASS iff every required case is discovered, at least one mandatory check is graded in a REQUIRED case, and no graded check is false (required cases with nothing gradable are listed NOT_RUN and make coverage 'partial'; extra cases never enable success); FAIL if any graded check is false; NO_VERDICT with a nonzero exit when no mandatory check is graded in the required set; a missing (or unusable) required case is refused before any evidence is written. Per-fit None stays a documented NOT_RUN exception (see t60_note per case) and never counts as a graded pass.
